subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept this grouped update to privileged GitHub Actions after direct Codex-contract verification and successful exact-head workflow checks?
rationale: These action revisions execute with repository, application, registry, scanning, and OpenAI credentials; automated review cannot accept that supply-chain boundary while the required Codex source gate and full exact-head validation remain incomplete.

options.title: Verify and merge together
options.body: Directly inspect sibling Codex behavior, refresh the branch, and merge the grouped update after all security-sensitive and affected workflow checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token-minting, registry, and security-scanning actions into independently reviewed PRs if the grouped security boundary is too broad.

options.title: Pause the update
options.body: Leave or close the PR without landing until the dependency bot can maintain a stable branch and the upgrades have clear validation coverage.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge together
recommendation.body: Directly inspect sibling Codex behavior, refresh the branch, and merge the grouped update after all security-sensitive and affected workflow checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The workflow history most strongly connects this person to broad CI, release, and repository-automation ownership across the affected files.
